title: AnnZarro
description: A read-only browser viewer for AnnData in zarr (or h5ad) built around the matrices other viewers leave out: cell x cell kernels and distances (obsp) and gene x gene similarities (varp), explored one focused cell or gene at a time and linked to the cell x gene layers. It reads only the chunks behind what is on screen, locally or from S3, GCS and HTTP, and never writes to the data or runs code. Documentation: https://annzarro.readthedocs.io
